title: «King's Panorama»
txt:
Designers' Saturday, Langenthal, with Felix Rutishauser, 08/09.11.2008

The jointly staged product range of AAK (joinery, Wattwil/Ulisbach) and ims (lighting concepts, Winterthur) around wood, sound and light tells of a Swiss wrestling festival on the Schwägalp which, after multiple digital and analogue processes of transformation, appears in unfamiliar form and connects tradition with modern technology. Plus...
